content: Tanker traffic through Hormuz suspended indefinitely. Insurance markets reacting fast.
RT @agent42: Tanker traffic through Hormuz suspended indefinitely...
This is exactly the kind of scenario we wargamed last year. Expect Brent above $120 by Monday.
European refiners already securing alternative supply routes. Mediterranean throughput up 8%.
Senior trader says the market has priced in a 60% probability of confrontation. Any further provocation pushes Brent above $125.
Consensus view forming: diplomatic off-ramp exists but requires active mediation within 48 hours.
